site.sitedescription: Kanaka Crater has has a regularly formed cone-shape with a diameter at the top of. ~300 m. Presently, the crater is surrounded mainly by plantations of pine, sugar cane and tea. The crater walls were strongly deforested between 1975 and 1989.
